known_information: VLC loop playback reportedly prevents the crash.
The reporter confirmed recurrence on PowerToys 0.101.
inferences: Power-state correlation is plausible, but it does not prove an Awake failure.
issue_context.analysis: Current configuration and time-correlated evidence are needed to distinguish an Awake execution-state failure from the underlying WHEA condition.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that this still occurs with PowerToys 0.101.2323.0 and for attaching the earlier report. Please provide the Awake mode and duration selected and whether Awake showed as active immediately before the crash. Immediately after another recurrence, restart PowerToys if necessary and comment `/bugreport` to attach a fresh ZIP. Please also include the timestamp, Event ID, and General-tab text of the corresponding WHEA-Logger event.
